_note: Header and footer navigation. Never hardcode a nav link in a template.
_proposedNote: `primary` is what ships today, four items, which is what the header was signed off with. `primaryProposed` is the five-item version under review: it adds a top-level Order Online and turns Locations into a mega menu. It is rendered ONLY on /nav-preview/ (noindex) so it can be looked at before it goes live on all fifteen pages. To adopt it: replace the contents of `primary` with `primaryProposed`, point components/site-header.njk at the mega menu partial, and delete the preview routes. To reject it: delete `primaryProposed` and the preview routes and nothing else changes.

primaryProposed.label: Locations
primaryProposed.megaNote: Expands to the seven rooms from locations.json. North Park is absent on purpose: it is closed, and its page is unbuilt pending Sam's closure copy (Open Decision #5).

primaryProposed.label: Order Online
primaryProposed.ctaNote: The one nav item styled as an action. /order-online/ is the third-biggest page on the site (5,648 clicks) and currently has no header link at all. DESIGN_SYSTEM.md allows one red CTA per viewport; this is the header's, so page heroes must not put a second red beside it.
